facts.text: Fairmont Bab Al Bahr is a 5-star Abu Dhabi beach resort set on Abu Dhabi Creek.
facts.excerpt: Fairmont Bab Al Bahr is a 5-star Abu Dhabi beach resort with a stunning setting on Abu Dhabi Creek.

facts.text: The hotel offers panoramas over Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque.
facts.excerpt: offers unparalleled panoramas over the glittering white-marble minarets of iconic Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque.

facts.text: The hotel is a 15 minute drive from Zayed International Airport.
facts.excerpt: Located just a 15 min drive from Zayed International Airport

facts.text: The hotel has private sandy beaches.
facts.excerpt: private sandy beaches and events facilities.

facts.text: The hotel has 8 restaurants and bars.
facts.excerpt: 8 restaurants and bars

facts.text: Mazaj Bab Al Bahr is a restaurant at the hotel that serves The Emirati Table, a culinary journey.
facts.excerpt: Return to Mazaj Bab Al Bahr for The Emirati Table, an immersive culinary journey

facts.text: Fairmont Gold is a hotel-within-a-hotel experience at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Fairmont Gold at Fairmont Bab Al Bahr, where you are treated to an exclusive, privileged hotel-within-a-hotel experience

facts.text: Fairmont Gold guests have a private check-in and check-out area and access to the Fairmont Gold Lounge.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy exclusive Fairmont Gold access with a private check-in/out area, high-speed Wi-Fi, and entry to the Fairmont Gold Lounge

facts.text: The Fairmont Gold Lounge serves a complimentary continental breakfast, afternoon tea and evening drinks.
facts.excerpt: the Fairmont Gold Lounge featuring a complimentary continental breakfast, afternoon tea, evening drinks, hors d’oeuvres, and delightful sweets.

facts.text: The Fairmont Villa has a private pool and gym facility amid a garden.
facts.excerpt: spacious living area amidst garden with private pool & gym facility

facts.text: The Royal Suite has two custom designed bedrooms and a private dining area.
facts.excerpt: features two custom designed bedrooms, two bathrooms, a private dining area and a spacious living area

facts.text: The Presidential Suite is a penthouse suite with two bedrooms and views of Abu Dhabi Creek and Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque.
facts.excerpt: The penthouse suite features a spacious living area, two bedrooms and two well appointed bathrooms, views of Abu Dhabi Creek and Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque.

facts.text: One Bedroom Suite View King with kitchen has a sea view, a dining area for 4 guests and a kitchen area with appliances.
facts.excerpt: Bedroom suite with separate living area with sea view , dining area for 4 guests. kitchen area with appliances

facts.text: Standard Fairmont rooms feature walnut wood paneling and a five-piece bathroom.
facts.excerpt: highlighted by walnut wood paneling - unique lighting fixtures - a luxurious five-piece bathroom

facts.text: There is no spa on site at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Unfortunately, a tranquil spa retreat isn't available on-site at Fairmont Bab Al Bahr.

facts.text: The hotel has a pool complex and access to a nearby health club.
facts.excerpt: the hotel boasts a stunning pool complex and access to a nearby health club

facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: bringing furry companions isn't currently possible.

facts.text: Parking is included and valet parking is offered.
facts.excerpt: Parking included

facts.text: The hotel hosts weddings in the Saqr Ballroom or in an open-air setting overlooking Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque.
facts.excerpt: From the grandeur of the Saqr Ballroom to an open-air occasion overlooking Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque

facts.text: The hotel is close to attractions on Yas Island, including Ferrari World and Warner Bros. World.
facts.excerpt: including Ferrari World and Warner Bros. World™ Yas Island
